*Welcome to Late Night Roundup, a rundown of the previous night’s highlights that lets you sleep — and lets us get paid to watch comedy. Here are the*[50 best movies on Netflix right now](https://www.nytimes.com/interactive/2020/arts/television/best-movies-on-netflix.html) *.*


## Flight Risk


[The F.A.A. full ground stop](https://www.nytimes.com/2026/11/15/us/router-network-faa-airline-ground-stop.html) , only the second since the Sept. 11 attacks, was a hot topic on Monday’s late night, after thousands of flights were disrupted on Friday, affecting travelers across the country.


Jimmy Kimmel said that America learned “a very valuable lesson: We learned what happens when the only experience your secretary of transportation has when it comes to transportation is being on ‘Road Rules: All Stars’ on MTV.”


> “What a mess. Sometimes, it feels like maybe Elon and his DOGE bros shouldn’t have fired more than a thousand employees at the F.A.A.” *— JIMMY KIMMEL*


> “President Trump yesterday made his first public comments about Friday’s nationwide F.A.A. ground stop and blamed the Biden administration for an ‘old and broken’ air traffic control system. Yeah, why didn’t Biden fix it? Or, for that matter, the guy before Biden?” *— SETH MEYERS*
>
>
> “Dude, you’ve been president for six of the past 10 years. Why not go back further? Blame the Wright brothers for the spotty Wi-Fi. Also, if Biden’s made one thing clear, it’s that he’s an Amtrak guy.” *— SETH MEYERS*
>
>
> “One router? Hey, you know what fail-safe program we should design our aviation system to mirror? Christmas lights. One bulb! ‘Sorry, kids, there is no Christmas this year. One bulb went dead.’” *— JON STEWART*


## The Punchiest Punchlines (‘Turn Off America’ Edition)


> “More than 660 flights were grounded on Friday after the FAA issued a nationwide ground stop due to a malfunctioning router at a facility in Arkansas, which left as many as 400,000 travelers fighting over nine outlets.” *— SETH MEYERS*
>
>
> “They say it’s nothing nefarious. I don’t believe them. I mean, this could be a hack from China, could be a hack from Iran, could be a hack from A.I. itself, could be Selma Blair. We just don’t know.” *— BILL MAHER*


> “No fail-safes in the system, no redundancies — don’t you have a surge protector?” *— JON STEWART*
>
>
> “I can’t even order a Crunchwrap Supreme without two-factor authentication. But somehow, for the planes, there’s a ‘turn off America’ switch in *\[expletive\]* Arkansas!” *— JON STEWART*


## The Bits Worth Watching

## What We’re Excited About on Tuesday Night
